text:
mia: Pushed a compact mock for the stacktrace panel: adds a tiny copy button inline with each frame to copy frame + correlation token. Also moving global Export out of the sticky header into a secondary actions row. Link: https://redwood.design/mockups/1768300055.png
rory: Love the inline copy affordance. Two product notes: 1) We should be explicit about what the frame copy contains (frame signature vs file+line vs full stack). 2) Correlation token semantics: do we copy trace_id only, or trace_id:span_id? We should default to trace_id to avoid breaking existing links.
emily: UX nit: show a micro-tooltip on hover: "Copy correlation identifier" (avoid "ID"). For the frame copy, show "Copy frame location" and reveal the full text in a small toast so keyboard users can confirm without opening devtools. Also prefer a 1px heavier font for the inline buttons so contrast passes AA at 12px.
aria: Accessibility checklist: make inline copy buttons real <button> elements with aria-labels like "Copy correlation identifier for this trace". Use aria-live polite for success messages: "Correlation identifier copied to clipboard". If we truncate the token in UI, add visually-hidden text with full token format ("32 hex characters"). Keyboard requirement: copy should be triggerable via Space/Enter when focused, and show a visible focus ring.
mia: Regarding export placement: I moved it to a secondary actions row under the header to reduce clutter but keep discoverability. Should we still leave a copy in the kebab menu? Maybe duplicate for parity.
rory: Duplicate in kebab is fine. Also add export scope choices: "Export current request (.zip)", "Export full trace (.zip)", "Export errors (CSV)". For long exports start an async job and show a download link in the Downloads panel + toast with ETA. Also include an estimated size badge before starting if we can compute it.
emily: Copy text proposals: button: "Copy correlation identifier"; tooltip on hover: "Copies the trace identifier used to link events across logs and APM"; export label: "Export full trace (.zip)" and for request-scoped: "Export request (current spans) (.zip)".
aria: Color/contrast: inline copy icon currently uses 60% gray on off-white at 12px  fails AA. Use 80% gray or #0b61a4 for interactive elements. Also ensure focus state passes 3:1 for target size or add an outline.
mia: Implementation note for devs (from rory): use navigator.clipboard.writeText(trace_id) with try/catch fallback to a hidden textarea + document.execCommand('copy'). For trace+span: format trace_id + ':' + span_id. We'll default to trace_id unless user explicitly expands.
design-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood.design/previews/1768300055  feedback window open for 72h
